subject: POC: Atlas Payments - success criteria & KPI plan
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Nguyen <emma.nguyen@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up + POC planning next steps (Atlas Payments)

Hi Emma — great to connect this morning. Thanks for walking us through Atlas's payment dispute flow and the core goals you mentioned (cut disputed transaction resolution time, reduce manual review volume, and improve customer response SLAs). Recap + proposed next steps below so we’re aligned for a short POC: 

Call recap (high level)
- Primary objective: reduce manual review time for disputed transactions (target ~40% fewer manual interventions)
- Key data: ~200k messages/month, median response SLA today is 6 hours, peak concurrency ~120 requests/minute
- Success stakeholders: Emma (product), Carlos (security), Ops (TBD)

Proposed POC scope & timeline
- Duration: 4 weeks (2-week integration + 2-week evaluation)
- Integration: API routing to Redwood hosted endpoint, sample dataset (anonymized) of 10k representative requests
- Evaluation window: run perf and quality tests on both live traffic replay and synthetic load

Proposed success criteria / KPIs (initial)
- Latency: median end-to-end generation latency <= 120ms for single-turn inference at 512 tokens
- Throughput: support sustained 150 req/minute with p95 latency <= 300ms
- Cost: target unit cost <= $0.0025 per k token equivalent (we’ll capture tokens and ops breakdown)
- Quality: 90% match to ground-truth labels on sample eval set (F1 or accuracy metric we agree on)

Attachments: I’ve attached a short POC evaluation criteria doc and a spreadsheet template for the evaluation plan.

Next steps
1) You confirm stakeholders + test dataset delivery date (ideally by Fri 4/22)
2) We set access (API key + VPC/CIDR if needed) — cc’ing Laura to coordinate
3) We sign a short SOW (attached draft) and confirm start date

Happy to hop on a short call if you prefer to walk through.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
From: Emma Nguyen <emma.nguyen@atlaspayments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@atlaspayments.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + POC planning next steps (Atlas Payments)

Thanks Jordan — this is great and captures the conversation well. A few clarifications / asks: 

- Dataset: we can provide an anonymized sample of ~12k events by next Tuesday (4/22). Will include labels for dispute outcomes for quality eval.
- Security: Carlos will need to run a quick questionnaire. Can you loop in Dev for the SOC/infra details and a contact for network config?
- KPI nuance: for latency, we care most about median and p95 for the real-time classify endpoint (we use a 512-token cap in our pipeline). For batch rerank, we care about throughput more than p95.

Also, for quality metric — we typically measure both precision on 'escalate' decisions and recall on 'auto-resolve' classifications. If you can propose a sample eval sheet with those columns that’d help.

We’re supportive of a 4-week run. Assuming security checks are OK, Carlos and I can sign the SOW quickly.

—Emma
Emma Nguyen
Product Manager, Disputes
Atlas Payments
emma.nguyen@atlaspayments.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Nguyen <emma.nguyen@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-19T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: POC plan + eval template (attached)

Emma — thanks for the quick reply and the helpful details. I’ve updated the POC plan and the eval template to reflect precision/recall columns and separate real-time vs batch KPIs. See attached: redwood-poc-eval-criteria.md and poc-eval-spreadsheet.xlsx. Summary of changes below: 

Refined success criteria/KPIs
- Real-time classify endpoint (primary):
  - Latency: median <= 120ms, p95 <= 300ms for 512-token cap
  - Throughput: sustain 150 req/minute (burst to 250) with graceful degradation policies
  - Quality: precision >= 92% on 'escalate' label; recall >= 88% on 'auto-resolve' label (we can adjust thresholds after initial sweep)
- Batch rerank/processing (secondary):
  - Throughput goal: process 50k messages/hour with average per-request latency < 1s
  - Cost: target amortized cost <= $0.0018 per k token for bulk jobs using batching and quantized models

Measurement plan
- We’ll run a 7-day evaluation window after integration where we:
  1) Replay 10k anonymized events through the classify endpoint and capture metrics
  2) Run throughput load tests (synthetic) to validate sustained qps and p95
  3) Run quality tests using the labeled sample and capture precision/recall/F1

Ownership & timeline
- Integration owner (Redwood): Dev Patel (cc’d) — network + API key setup, sample ingestion
- Success owner (Atlas): Emma Nguyen — provides dataset and labels, coordinates Ops
- CS/Enablement: Marissa Cole — onboarding, runbook, and evaluation coordination
- Timeline: aim to start integration week of 4/25, evaluation week of 5/9, final review by 5/16

SOW & security
- I’ve attached the SOW draft. Carlos — if you can send the security questionnaire, Dev will respond within 48 hours.

Next actions (please reply to confirm)
- Emma: confirm dataset delivery date (4/22 OK) and integration start (week of 4/25)
- Carlos: security questionnaire next steps
- Marissa: I’d like you to confirm onboarding plan and internal runbook items

Thanks — I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff for Mon 4/26 to align on network/access and data delivery.

Best,
Jordan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Emma Nguyen <emma.nguyen@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC plan + eval template (attached)

Thanks all — I’ll own the evaluation coordination and runbook. A couple quick items from my side: 

- Kickoff meeting confirmed: Mon 4/26 10:00am PT (invite sent)
- Runbook items I’ll prepare: test data ingestion checklist, evaluation metrics dashboard (shared Drive), and nightly perf-summary email during the eval window
- Resource ask: Dev, can you confirm the API key provisioning process and whether Atlas needs any CIDR allowlist? If so, please send the exact steps + expected ETA.

I’ll update the poc-eval-spreadsheet with the precision/recall thresholds and a sample scoring script snippet before the kickoff.

Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: POC plan + eval template (attached)

All good from Atlas — dataset delivery confirmed for 4/22 and Carlos here has kicked off the internal security questionnaire. We’re aligned on the timeline and KPIs as listed. Looking forward to the kickoff on 4/26.

—Carlos
